issues.description: Method mismatch for SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber(): The problem statement (UML and task description) specifies a method calculateRemainingOrderNumber() that returns an int representing the number of remaining orders. In the solution implementation (SealSaloon.java) the method is declared as public void calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and prints order numbers instead of returning an int (and also computes remainingOrders as this.orders.length + 1, which does not match the described semantics). This discrepancy between the required API (int return) and the solution implementation will confuse students about the expected signature and behaviour and may cause tests that expect an int return value to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification: change the method signature to public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and return the number of remaining orders (e.g., return this.orders.length). If printing example lines is desired for demonstration, keep printing separate from the method or print but still return the integer. Also correct the calculation (remove the +1) so the returned value equals the actual remaining orders.
